scope: Actual first provider request only; schema presence is not model compliance or runtime receipt execution. No raw thinking copied.
goal_measure_description:
Record an explicit observation of a Goal's declared metric. Supply the exact
current criterion_revision from masc_goal_list, the observed value, and
supporting evidence. This records a reported value; it does not prove
that the target was reached or change the Goal phase. The receipt returns
measurement_status=reported_only, the actual goal_at_recording from the same
transaction, and completion_effect=unchanged. Report its phase accurately:
measurement is not verification or completion. Goal completion requires
separate verifier proof and final human confirmation; Task approval does
not substitute for either.
task_list_description: List backlog tasks. Rows carry id, title, priority, created_at, status, assignee and lifecycle timestamps; projection=full adds completion notes, description, files, contract, handoff_context, execution_links. awaiting_verification means the task awaits the completion-authority verdict and no Keeper can claim it; never Read producer sandbox paths. Rows are ordered by priority, then created_at, then id. When truncated is true the response carries next_cursor; pass it as cursor with the same status, include_done and projection to read the rows after that page. The last page has none. new_tasks highlights recent off-page rows only on the first page; continuation pages do not repeat that discovery window. Narrow by task_ids, assignee, goal_id or a literal query before paging; all supplied filters are ANDed and must stay the same on continuation pages. Use task_ids with projection=full for known tasks instead of scanning the whole backlog. Exact task_ids lookups include every lifecycle state when status and include_done are both omitted; general discovery excludes done and cancelled tasks. Explicit lifecycle filters keep their stated meaning.

include_done.description: Explicit false excludes done and cancelled; true includes done but excludes cancelled. An explicit status takes precedence. When omitted, exact task_ids lookups include every state; general discovery excludes done and cancelled.
